title: Accounts Receivable Clause: Parking Catch-Up Amount on a Returned Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Bank Draft
content:
**Clause.** For a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement catch-up draft under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the returned parking due date is the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date. The parking catch-up amount is the parking rent charge of the returned due date, which is the contracted monthly rent less the parking class's military discount rate where the military discount is applied, rounded to the cent. The parking catch-up amount is never below zero and is rounded to the cent once.

**Records.** The parking agreement's delinquent-since date (its oldest unpaid due date), its contracted monthly rent, whether the military discount is applied on it, and its parking class's military discount rate.

**Restated as condition and result.** Where the military discount is applied, the parking catch-up amount is the contracted monthly rent times one minus the military discount rate, rounded to the cent; where it is not, it is the contracted monthly rent.

**Hypothetical figures.**

| Contracted monthly rent | Military discount | Parking catch-up amount |
|---|---|---|
| $185.00 | not applied | $185.00 |
| $185.00 | applied, 10% | $166.50 |
| $64.99 | applied, 10% | $58.49 (from $58.491) |

A parking agreement delinquent since 3 January, with 3 February also unpaid, has 3 January as its returned parking due date (hypothetical dates).
